clips.title: The story
paras: Investigate the Camp is an expedition task originating in Booty Bay to scout a newly established hunters' campsite in Stranglethorn Vale. Commissioned by Krazek, it tasks travelers with confirming rumors that the legendary dwarven marksman Hemet Nesingwary has arrived near Lake Nazferiti.

Reports circulating through the docks of Booty Bay speak of an expedition of big-game hunters encamped in the northern jungles of Stranglethorn Vale. Word has reached Krazek that the camp lies along the river just past the Venture Company's busy mining claim near Lake Nazferiti. In a lawless jungle teeming with dangers and competing interests, unexplained armed encampments always demand a watchful eye.

What makes this particular expedition notable is the rumored presence of Hemet Nesingwary himself. The renowned dwarven marksman is known throughout the lands as an elite explorer with influential ties. Krazek prefers to take no chances with powerful figures operating in the hinterlands, sending scouts upriver to confirm whether the legendary hunter has truly arrived.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: I've gotten reports of a group of hunters that have set up camp upriver of the Venture Company mining camp on Lake Nazferiti. Now, normally I wouldn't care, but improbably, I heard that Hemet Nesingwary was one of the hunters there? He's certainly well-connected, if you catch my meaning, and you never can be too safe.
Why don't you go check out the camp, friend, see what they're about?
